scope: Synthetic local retrieval and exact-target adversarial checks; not production model safety certification.

documents.title: JWT authentication
documents.content: JWT authentication requires an Authorization Bearer token. Only an administrator can ingest documents. A USER can query the shared knowledge collection. Cookies do not authenticate requests.

documents.title: Refund policy
documents.content: Refund requests have a fourteen day window. Open the local order receipt and select Request refund. Approved refunds restore the simulated payment balance; no real funds are transferred.

documents.title: Backup recovery
documents.content: Backups use daily snapshots. Restore a snapshot into an isolated collection and verify document counts and hashes before switching traffic. Recovery tests must preserve the original database.

documents.title: Reminder timezone
documents.content: Reminder schedules use the user's IANA timezone. Weekday routines skip Saturday and Sunday. A delivered reminder has a stable identifier to avoid duplicate inbox messages.

documents.title: Secret rotation
documents.content: Secret rotation creates a new version, validates access, then retires the old version. If validation fails, restore the previous version and record the failed rotation. Never print secret values.

documents.title: Untrusted reference example
